candidates.name: pglite-oxide
candidates.fit_for_gap: G3-desktop-data: OPTIONAL ENHANCEMENT over the embedded-SurrealDB baseline (cand-009) on platforms where it works — embedded PostgreSQL 17.5 (PGlite WASI guest in Rust host), PG wire protocol so sqlx connects unchanged. RESOLVED 2026-07-16 (pglite-oxide-intel-mac-spike): FAILS TO COMPILE on x86_64-apple-darwin — not usable on this platform, not merely unverified. See open_questions.

evidence.claim: MIT, 90 stars, pushed 2026-07-15 (same day as this analysis) — small but actively developed

AOT assets: aarch64-apple-darwin, aarch64/x86_64-linux-gnu, x86_64-windows-msvc, portable-wasix. NO x86_64-apple-darwin AOT — this project's primary dev machine is an Intel Mac; portable WASIX fallback unverified there. GATING SPIKE REQUIRED before adoption is irreversible.
0.5.1 on crates.io, 4,192 downloads; companion pglite-oxide-assets crate 3,183

LIVE SPIKE RESULT (2026-07-16): FAIL. `cargo run` on x86_64-apple-darwin fails during dependency compilation — wasmer-wasix 0.702.0-alpha.3 (pglite-oxide's own transitive WASIX-runtime dep, the only path available since no AOT crate exists for this triple) has a non-exhaustive match against virtual-net 0.702.0's NetworkError enum (E0004, missing NetworkError::MessageSize arm). A real upstream version-incompatibility bug between two of pglite-oxide's own pinned deps, not a platform-support gap this project can work around. Boot/query timings were never obtainable — compilation never succeeded.

open_questions: RESOLVED 2026-07-16 (pglite-oxide-intel-mac-spike, live spike, not just analysis): pglite-oxide is NOT usable on x86_64-apple-darwin in any configuration — desktop-data-layer-pglite-oxide (change 11) treats this platform as SurrealDB-only, no retry needed unless upstream ships a wasmer-wasix/virtual-net compatibility fix. Still viable on aarch64-apple-darwin, Linux, and Windows per its AOT assets (unverified by this spike, which was scoped to Intel Mac only). Second-engine concern remains resolved on platforms where it does work: SurrealDB was already a UAR dependency, so pglite-oxide is genuinely additive there, not a second required engine.
